panel.label: Approved 294-game research panel
panel.note: This exact 294-game prototype is approved. The original 300-slot target and six unfilled recent-release slots remain recorded; membership and admission rules are unchanged.

reviewActivity.note: Review creation intervals are independent of release-cohort windows; only exact saved validated intervals are comparable.

notes: Application types and verified Steam date bases remain separate from source-reported IGDB PC metadata.
First playable includes Early Access; full release requires separate Steam1.0 evidence. PC dates establish neither.
Release membership uses UTC [start,end). Custom release dates include both selected days.
Review7/30-day or custom activity windows measure reviews independently of release membership.
AsOf excludes future retrieval/observation evidence. Broad catalog metadata is versioned by retrieval; other historical taxonomy changes cannot be reconstructed.
One equal weight per observed eligible game per source category; raw categories overlap and can be unclassified.
Median is primary; mean, R7 quartiles/IQR, trimmed mean at n≥20 and largest-game share describe dispersion with sample warnings.
No calibrated popularity score, sales, revenue or causal marketing estimate is introduced.
